topic: Access issues in Mops for facility data
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on a user having difficulty accessing necessary data within the Mops system, despite having access in Analytics. The required information includes setting up assets and listing facility names/boxes.

[me] suggested that since there might be compatibility issues, [p1] try accessing the data separately within Mops first. If this fails, [me] offered to attempt fixing the issue the next day, though noted that the system is in a state of disarray and repairs would be difficult. As an alternative, [me] suggested finding another login for the user.
decisions: Attempting access fixes for Mops data will be attempted by [me] the following day.
action_items: [p1] to provide their account credentials if necessary.
